import importlib.util
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485492/attempts/9f509ca37a0f4b279e3de00a5074f14c/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = []
    for tile_r in range(3):
        for r in range(n):
            row = []
            rr = n - 1 - r if tile_r != 1 else r
            for tile_c in range(3):
                for c in range(m):
                    cc = m - 1 - c if tile_c != 1 else c
                    row.append(grid[rr][cc])
            out.append(row)
    return out
'''
